test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

P O _ _ Y _ _ I U Y _ O I _ Y P O _ U _
solution:
Given : P O _ _ Y _ _ I U Y _ O I _ Y P O _ U _

Lets check each option:

1) U,I,P,O,P,U,I,Y → PO__**UI**__Y - __**PO**__IUY - __**P**__OI__**U**__Y - PO__**I**__U__**Y**__

No pattern followed

2) I,O,P,U,P,U,I,Y → PO__**IO**__Y - **__PU__**IUY - __**P**__OI__**U**__Y - PO__**I**__U__**Y**__ 

No pattern followed

3) I,O,P,U,P,O,I,Y → PO__**IO**__Y - __**PU**__IUY - __**P**__OI__**O**__Y - PO__**I**__U__**Y**__ 

No pattern followed

4) I,U,P,O,P,U,I,Y →** **PO**__IU__**Y** **- __**PO**__IUY - __**P**__OI**__U__**Y - PO**__I__**U**__Y__**

**'POIUY**' is repeating itself.

Hence,** 'option 4' **is the correct answer.
